title: Velo Client 1.3.2: the server owner update
summary: An owner panel for Velo Bridge servers, real Velo menus, HUD elements, cutscenes, music zones and NPC cosmetics - plus updates that install themselves.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.3.2** gives servers with **Velo Bridge 1.2** a lot more to show you - and the launcher now updates itself in the background.

blocks.caption: Server menus open as real Velo windows.

items: **Server menus** open as Velo windows: buttons, lists with item icons, input fields, toggles and sliders
**Server HUD**: quest progress, boss bars, event timers and pictures - move it like any HUD element
**Cutscenes**: smooth camera flights with letterbox and titles for intros and events
**Music zones**: music that fades in and out as you walk around a server
**Server notes**: on servers that allow it, pin World Notes everyone there can see
**NPCs in Velo cosmetics**: servers can dress their NPCs in cloaks, wings, auras, bodywear and pets

blocks.text: Don't want any of it? Settings of the **Server HUD** module: switch server music or cutscenes off any time.

blocks.caption: The owner panel: live numbers and every setting in one page.

items: Run **/velobridge panel** and open the link: players online, Velo versions, modules and join times
Change every setting with live previews - saved to your server within seconds
Design NPCs like in the Locker, with a 3D preview and your own cloaks

blocks.caption: Dressing an NPC in the panel.

items: New versions **download in the background**; a small card offers **Restart to update**
Download progress right in your notifications
Downloads come from **Velo's own servers first** - about twice as fast, GitHub only as a backup
Windows: the update no longer stalls with a console window - it asks for permission once and installs quietly
Switch it off in Settings: **Automatic updates**
The Velo menu no longer opens and closes over and over when its key is held
Fixed a crash on 26.3 with some shader mods when a 3D player preview with cosmetics was shown
Fixed a rare crash on 1.21.10 / 1.21.11 with the GPU Utilization HUD
Velo Library: custom poses on the render page, steadier animated renders, better crouch and dab
